android.versioning_policy: semantic version name; monotonically increasing integer version code

release_signing.secret_transport: environment variables / protected CI secrets only

completion_requirements: application id accepted by distribution console
release toolchain and target API rechecked against Google Play policy immediately before public release
release keystore generated and backed up outside repository
signed release AAB produced and signature verified
note: The stable application id and Android toolchain baseline are persisted early because changing package identity after store publication creates a different Android application and relying on implicit SDK defaults creates avoidable release drift. 12.2 remains in progress until real release signing, policy recheck, artifact inspection and console acceptance are proven.
